blocks: 1. A new permission "Received later" appears in the Work Orders section of the permissions page, as a yes/no toggle rather than a CRUD row.
2. It allows deferring a receive that would otherwise block completion.
3. It is off by default in every role and is granted per role.
4. It is the only atom this release adds; everything else reuses an existing atom.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9267 (Story 21, Permissions on the new surfaces) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), and the permission map SV-8183, read on 9 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.

44607.title: Every Simple Flow action is gated by its mapped existing atom

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin to read the permission map in Settings -> "Roles & Permissions" (left sidebar) -> click the pencil on a role to open its permission toggles; then, to check gating, use TECH@shopview.com whose role is set for this test (reset the role from Settings -> Roles & Permissions, then assign it to TECH; never change the Admin role) with only the mapped atom for each Simple Flow action (WO Lines: Create & Edit; Order Parts; Pick Parts; Vendor & Order Mgmt: Create & Edit; Received later; See Financial Data).
2. For each Simple Flow action, confirm it is available only when its mapped existing atom is granted.

blocks: 1. Settings page follows Settings > App Settings; completing a line or work order follows Work Orders: Create & Edit.
2. Approving, declining, reordering parts, tech story, mileage, engine hours and core decisions follow WO Lines: Create & Edit plus Full View.
3. Picking follows Pick Parts; ordering and receiving on a work order follow Order Parts (which requires See Financial Data).
4. The purchase order pages and assigning a vendor follow Vendor & Order Mgmt: Create & Edit; fixing a part number into the catalogue follows Catalog & Inventory: Create & Edit.
5. Marking reviewed follows Review Work Orders; creating the invoice follows Invoicing & Payments: Create & Edit plus See Financial Data.
6. The bulk version of an action is governed by exactly the same atom as the single version - no bulk action introduces a gate of its own.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9267 (Story 21, Permissions on the new surfaces) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), and the permission map SV-8183, read on 9 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.

44608.title: Money follows See Financial Data; work follows View mode

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin; for the checks, use TECH@shopview.com whose role is set for this test (reset the role from Settings -> Roles & Permissions, then assign it to TECH; never change the Admin role) with See Financial Data ON vs OFF and View mode Full vs Tech.
2. Open a work order and the receive/PO surfaces and confirm money fields follow See Financial Data and the work UI follows View mode.
custom_preconds.text:
1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin; for the checks, use TECH@shopview.com whose role is set for this test (reset the role from Settings -> Roles & Permissions, then assign it to TECH; never change the Admin role) with See Financial Data ON vs OFF and View mode Full vs Tech.
2. Open a work order and the receive/PO surfaces and confirm money fields follow See Financial Data and the work UI follows View mode.

blocks: 1. As a user without See Financial Data, open a receive surface and check money fields.
2. Compare Tech View vs Full View for which actions/columns of work show.
custom_steps.text:
1. As a user without See Financial Data, open a receive surface and check money fields.
2. Compare Tech View vs Full View for which actions/columns of work show.

blocks: 1. See Financial Data governs money (cost, tax, subtotals, totals, sell price); View mode (Tech/Full) governs which actions and columns of work a user sees - they never compete on the same row.

2. No money field is ever both hidden and required: receiving needs a cost and a tax, both always prefilled, so a user without See Financial Data receives with those fields removed and the existing values standing.
3. Where a user cannot see money, those fields are removed rather than masked, and no text that reveals a price by implication is rendered (such as a cost-vs-sell warning).

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9267 (Story 21, Permissions on the new surfaces) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), and the permission map SV-8183, read on 9 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.

44609.title: A user without an atom never sees the action; hidden values are not sent

blocks: 1. For each check, use TECH@shopview.com whose role is set for this test (reset the role from Settings -> Roles & Permissions, then assign it to TECH; never change the Admin role) WITHOUT the relevant atom (e.g. without Order Parts, or without Pick Parts).
2. Open the work order / receive surfaces and confirm the gated action is not shown, and that a hidden value is never submitted.
custom_preconds.text:
1. For each check, use TECH@shopview.com whose role is set for this test (reset the role from Settings -> Roles & Permissions, then assign it to TECH; never change the Admin role) WITHOUT the relevant atom (e.g. without Order Parts, or without Pick Parts).
2. Open the work order / receive surfaces and confirm the gated action is not shown, and that a hidden value is never submitted.

blocks: 1. As a user missing an atom, look for the action in the bulk bar and on the row.
2. Inspect whether values behind hidden money fields reach the screen.
custom_steps.text:
1. As a user missing an atom, look for the action in the bulk bar and on the row.
2. Inspect whether values behind hidden money fields reach the screen.

blocks: 1. A user without an atom does not see the action at all, in the bulk action bar or on the row - nothing is shown and then refused.
2. The values behind a hidden field are not sent to a screen that is not allowed to show them.
3. Creating a new vendor keeps the existing vendor-management permission wherever it is offered.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9267 (Story 21, Permissions on the new surfaces) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), and the permission map SV-8183, read on 9 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.
